description: Pattern: "왜 멈췄니?" typed while a long command runs. Needs the decision composition (--decisions with a key): EGDESK_INRUN_MESSAGES (a message while the run works), EGDESK_CONVERSATION_FLOW and EGDESK_DRAFT_CHECK=on (held, checked messages). The second turn carries whileRunning: it is sent while the first turn still works (afterMs after that turn started). The command is not interrupted and finishes; a short reply is posted for the question. Expectations are code checks only.
